description:
A modern and secure instant messaging for people, business and healthcare


[Feature] Chat Window: Link previews can stay hidden until you click them
[Changed] Chat Window: Photos and files sent through Trillian now show even with link previews off
[Changed] Chat Window: Tenor links show as plain links, and the GIF browser uses KLIPY
[Changed] Contact List: Initials skip titles such as Dr.
[Fixed] Chat Window: Copying text from the right-click menu now clears the selection highlight
[Fixed] Chat Window: Custom emoji at the start of a message now draw at the same size as the rest of the line
[Fixed] Chat Window: Links in prompts are readable in the dark theme
[Fixed] Chat Window: Search no longer hides contacts behind channels with similar names
[Fixed] Chat Window: Slash commands no longer trigger the domain disclaimer
[Fixed] Chat Window: The delete message prompt now closes when the connection drops
[Fixed] Chat Window: The prompt for closing all chats can be canceled with its close box or the escape key
[Fixed] Chat Window: The scroll-down arrow is now visible in the dark theme
[Fixed] Contact List: Initials are correct for names that use newer emoji
[Fixed] Contact List: Removing a cloned contact now says which group it is being removed from
[Fixed] Contact List: The Trillian bot no longer shows in teams
